termo:Eridu ziggurat.descricao: Rough map of the Eridu mound showing the main ziggurat, temple, and a few buildings
Eridu, southwest of Nasiriyah, Iraq, is considered the world's first city and the ziggurat depicted here may be the oldest temple on earth.
Some of the baked bricks used in the construction of the Sumerian ziggurat at Eridu, southwest of Nasiriyah, Iraq, are stamped with the name of King Ur-Nammu (2123-2106 BC).
